title: Long-range magnetic interaction of native defects in transition metal dichalcogenides
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,6585-6592
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08374A, Paper
Open Access

Prashant Vijay Gaikwad, T. Thuy Hoang, Sungjin Park, Junhyeok Bang
Long-range magnetic interaction between native cation antisite defects (MS) can induce ferromagnetism in transition metal dichalcogenides, such as WS2 and MoS2, without any doping of magnetic elements.
